trophies.guide: The reward for everything else: finish the story, all side strands, every activity and every collectible. Follow the roadmap in order — story first, then side content, then collectibles, then the 100% sweep — and the platinum will pop on its own.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: The opening mission. Follow the on-screen prompts and the fishing tutorial; it ends automatically when you return to shore. Nothing here can be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1's missions in order. The trophy pops at the chapter's final cutscene. Do the meditation spot in this chapter before moving on — see Positive Mental Attitude.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every Chapter 2 mission. The chapter closes with a story beat that awards the trophy; there is no optional objective tied to it.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Clear Chapter 3's missions. By now the map is mostly open, so grab the meditation spots and stunt jumps you pass along the way.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The trophy unlocks at the end of the chapter's last mission; keep a manual save before the finale in case you want to replay it.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the last story mission. It is a long one, so stock up on ammo and armour beforehand; the gold pops when the credits roll.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is an early story mission. Drive carefully — the mission fails if your partner's car takes too much damage — and the trophy pops on completion.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a multi-stage job. Follow the crew's plan, use cover during the shootout, and the trophy unlocks when the crew gets away clean.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Child's Play is a story mission about family business. It is mostly driving and dialogue; finish it and the trophy is yours.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Headliners is a loud, chaotic mission. Keep moving during the finale and use Combat Focus to clear the last room; the trophy pops at the end.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown takes you into the airport. Stay low, follow the marker, and the trophy unlocks once the takedown is done.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a big set-piece. Expect a long firefight; use cover and your partner's revives, and the trophy pops when the operation ends.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The 100% checklist covers story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and stunts. Work through the in-game stats page — it shows exactly what is left — and save this for last.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Stunts are jumps, near-misses and airtime. The easiest farm is the airport runway: jump the ramps, land, and repeat. The counter is cumulative across the whole game.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: There are 9 activity types: races, fishing, shooting range, drone races, arcade, bowling, darts, pool and golf. Try each once — you do not need to win, just participate.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: There are 42 Shooting Range challenges. Use a rifle with a scope for the long targets and a pistol for the close ones; gold needs speed and accuracy, so learn each lane before timing it.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: There are 14 drone race locations. Learn the gates on a practice run first, then race for real; the trophy pops when the last location is won.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 distinct races across street, off-road and water. Replays of the same race do not count — use the map to find races you have not won yet.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge Cal at the fishing spot and out-fish him. Use the heavier lure for bigger catches and keep your line tension in the green zone.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish any arcade game to the end. Pick the shortest one — the racing cabinet is the quickest — and the trophy pops at the results screen.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's mission strand ends with a redemption job. Finish his last mission and the trophy unlocks; his strand is available from mid-game.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's strand ends on the water. Bring a fast boat and watch for the patrol boats; the trophy pops when his last job is done.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's final mission is a long ride. Keep your bike upright and follow the route; the trophy unlocks at the end of his strand.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Find 8 stranger strands marked on the map and finish each one. Some strands only appear at certain times of day, so check the map after each story chapter. Note: the full set of strands is still being mapped by the community, so this is marked unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's strand ends with a supply run. Drive the cargo carefully — damage reduces the payout — and the trophy pops on delivery.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's last mission is a spin through the city. Follow his lead, keep the car in one piece, and the trophy unlocks at the end.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots. WARNING: this is the one missable trophy — the Chapter 1 meditation spot may become unavailable once you leave the chapter, so meditate at every spot you find as you find it. The spots are marked by a lotus icon; the guide lists all 18 locations. Whether the Chapter 1 spot is strictly required is still unconfirmed, so do not skip it.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret asks you to hunt a unique animal. Track it with the scent trail and take the shot from cover — a clean kill matters. The exact animal is still unconfirmed, so this is marked unconfirmed until the community pins it down.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Collectible cards are hidden in shops, houses and vehicles. There are several sets; complete any 3. Use the in-game collection screen to see which cards you still need.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It spots are marked on the map once you are near them. There are 100 across Leonida; do them as you explore and the trophy pops at the 100th.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Challenges are small feats — stunts, kills, races, collections. The counter is cumulative; play naturally and it will hit 50, or grind the easy ones like stunt jumps.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Get a 4-star wanted level with your partner in the car, then lose the cops — hide in an alley or switch cars. The trophy pops once the wanted level clears.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner, keeping your wanted level the whole time. Do not let it drop between robberies — plan a route with three close shops.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles by driving them. Variety counts — cars, bikes, boats, planes. The discovery log in the pause menu shows your count.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus in a room with at least 5 enemies and drop them all before it ends. The police station shootout is a good spot — lots of enemies, tight space.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave VCIA in a way the airport did not schedule — steal a plane or a service vehicle and get airborne. The trophy pops once you are clear of the airport.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhino tanks — steal one, destroy one, or survive one. The military base has them; bring heavy weapons and keep moving.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob the jewelry store without tripping the alarm or being spotted. Go at night, cut the power first if you can, and leave before the police arrive.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Plan your exit before you go in — a fast car parked nearby makes the escape much easier.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and get away. Ram it to stop it, grab the cash, and lose the wanted level — a tunnel or a car swap helps.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Visit all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you go; the last few are the small islands and the far north, so check the map for blank patches.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs. The operations are marked once you scout them; do one per gang and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Order a cocktail at the Ocean Beach bar and watch the view. It is a quiet moment — just sit through the scene and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash out of a vehicle showroom in style — drive straight through the glass. Any showroom works; pick one with a clear road outside.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a full game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. You do not need a high score — just finish the game.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal — it unlocks during a story beat with your partner. It pops automatically; just keep playing the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make choices through the story — PSN tracks a count up to 500. It is cumulative across playthroughs, so it will pop as you play; there is no single choice that unlocks it.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try — fail something, then succeed at it right after. No confirmed trigger has been pinned down yet, so this is marked unconfirmed; try a failed mission retry or a failed stunt, then land it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — a UFO sighting or a weird event in the world. Roam the desert at night and keep an eye on the sky; it pops when the event triggers.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by — swing a bat from a moving car. Do it at low speed in a crowded area so the hit connects.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from heists; the laundering contact takes a cut, so keep running jobs until the total hits $250,000.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, cars, food. It is cumulative; buy the expensive stuff (cars and weapons) to reach it fast.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. They are marked on the map once you have the cash; each one is a separate purchase.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Drive a vehicle, open the app, and register it — any 10 vehicles count.
trophies.name: On the Spot
